_comment: Machine-readable product claims registry. Every public-facing claim must appear here. CI validates this file on every commit.

claims.claim: Teachers can take attendance offline on supported mobile phone cameras. Data saves to local storage and syncs when reconnected.
claims.limitations: Requires browser camera permission. Firefox mobile background sync requires user interaction on reconnect.

claims.claim: Zebra FX9600 IoT Connector webhook JSON tag-read payload specification compatible and verified against documented contracts.
claims.limitations: Software contract simulation only. No physical FX9600 hardware tested. Physical commissioning is EXTERNALLY_PENDING.

claims.claim: Physical on-site Zebra FX9600 reader gate commissioning requires on-site RF calibration, doorway tuning, and technician acceptance.
claims.limitations: No physical hardware available. Must not be described as production-certified without signed commissioning report from docs/hardware/FX9600_COMMISSIONING_TEMPLATE.md.

claims.claim: PostgreSQL Row-Level Security enforces strict tenant separation. Cross-tenant data access is blocked at the database level.
claims.limitations: Requires correct role configuration. Tested in CI with real PostgreSQL 16.

claims.claim: Automated AES-256-CBC encrypted appliance database snapshots with SHA-256 integrity checksum manifests.
claims.limitations: AES-256-CBC provides confidentiality but is unauthenticated. Integrity is protected by SHA-256 manifest checksum + self-test decryption. Full AEAD (AES-GCM) is on the migration roadmap.

claims.claim: Cloudflare R2 off-site backup replication with SigV4 authentication and integrity validation drill.
claims.limitations: Unit tests use mocked R2 API. Real off-site replication requires live R2 credentials. Status: EXTERNALLY_PENDING for live credentials validation.

claims.claim: Transactional absence notification jobs are queued in PostgreSQL upon session finalization.
claims.limitations: Queue creation and processing are automation-verified. Live carrier delivery requires DLT credentials and is EXTERNALLY_PENDING.

claims.claim: Carrier SMS dispatch requires active school DLT principal entity registration and telecom sender credentials.
claims.limitations: No DLT credentials available. Must not be presented as verified carrier delivery without authentic delivery receipts.

claims.claim: Automated WCAG 2.1/2.2 Level AA rule auditing across all key routes, dialogs, and navigation via axe-core.
claims.limitations: Automated axe-core covers rule-based WCAG violations. Does not substitute for human assistive-technology evaluation.

claims.claim: Formal assistive technology evaluations with native TalkBack, VoiceOver, and NVDA human users are planned.
claims.limitations: No human UAT evidence. Must not be described as human-certified accessible until signed evaluation reports are filed in EXTERNAL_VALIDATION_REGISTER.md.

claims.claim: Reports are generated for school administrative review. Official department acceptance is determined by authorized education authorities.
claims.limitations: No government acceptance obtained. Must not be described as government-approved or UDISE+-certified.

claims.claim: Complete English, Bengali, and Hindi interfaces across all dashboards, wizard flows, and public pages.
claims.limitations: Hindi coverage is primarily landing pages and onboarding. Some admin workflows are English-dominant.

claims.claim: One-command production installation on Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 LTS (amd64).
claims.limitations: Tested on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-22.04 and ubuntu-24.04 runners (amd64 only).

claims.claim: Installation script supports ARM64 (aarch64) architecture detection and installation.
claims.limitations: ARM64 path is code-implemented but has no native CI runner validation. EXTERNALLY_PENDING native arm64 runner test. See docs/audit/BASELINE_AUDIT.md blocker B-3.

claims.claim: Container images are signed with Cosign keyless OIDC signing and have SLSA build-provenance attestation.
claims.limitations: Signing executes in the release workflow on tag push. Not executed on main branch pushes.

claims.claim: Prometheus + Alertmanager monitoring with alert rules for application, database, backup, SMS worker, and RFID gateway.
claims.limitations: Monitoring is opt-in profile. Alert delivery requires ALERT_EMAIL_TO or ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL to be configured. Dead-man heartbeat alert is present.
